objs.name: document
objs.description: Core document in P&R Management system; can have versions, status, language, validity, etc.

objs.name: documenttype
objs.description: Type of document (Policy, Guideline, Work Instruction, etc.)

objs.name: documenttemplate
objs.description: Template used when creating documents; can specify metadata.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: External file or document attached to Document.

objs.name: equipment
objs.description: Equipment or tools attached to Document; has its own versioning.

objs.name: masterdata
objs.description: Master data referenced by documents (IT applications, areas of validity, etc.).

objs.name: usergroup
objs.description: Group of users with a specific authorization role.

objs.name: changeproposal
objs.description: Proposal to change a document; can be created/edited/approved.

evts.name: createdocument
evts.description: New document created; associated with a DocumentType, Template.

evts.name: attachobject
evts.description: Attachment, AdditionalInfo or Equipment attached to Document.

evts.name: releasedocument
evts.description: Document released with signature and versioning.

evts.name: translatedocument
evts.description: Document translated into another language; translation must be released.

evts.name: extendvalidity
evts.description: Extend validity of a document; creates validity extension request.

evts.name: overridedocument
evts.description: Override (AKS) of a document; may influence validity and archiving.

evts.name: reactivatedocument
evts.description: Reactivate an invalidated document; new version created.

evts.name: distributedocumentemail
evts.description: Distribution by email when a new version is released; not required actions.

evts.name: createchangeproposal
evts.description: Create a Change Proposal for a Document.
